name: Geolonia Test Addresses
description: Real addresses from the test suite of Geolonia normalize-japanese-addresses (MIT), test/addresses/addresses.csv, checked 2026-10-09 at commit 4e694d6 (github.com/geolonia/normalize-japanese-addresses). That file holds 7,191 addresses; taken here are every tenth row in file order (sample), every row Geolonia annotated with a note (notedByGeolonia), and every row whose town is written otherwise than its official form or whose block carries a room (writtenDifferently). Ten rows are left out, because what follows the town is not an address (以下未定, two buildings each with its own lot number) or the town is not written at all. Expected values are converted from Geolonia's columns: the town keeps its spelling as written, its 丁目 becomes chome, and Geolonia's block or remainder becomes ban, go, a room (a fourth number), then the building, floor and room.
